Description: Per-trial task properties from the NIX metadata section Session/Trial properties.

trial.Description: Trial number (1-based); equals nTrial in ds004752 events.tsv.

set_size.Description: Number of letters to memorize (4, 6 or 8).

match.Description: Probe membership as coded in the NIX source

Levels.1: IN (probe was in the memory set)
Levels.2: OUT (probe was not in the memory set)

correct.Description: Response correctness as coded in the NIX source

response.Description: Button code of the response as stored in the NIX source (raw value, not interpreted; the source and Boran et al. 2020 do not document the code-to-button mapping).

artifact.Description: NIX Artifact flag for the trial

Levels.1: trial marked as artifact by the authors
